# `passportsim power`

Press or hold the power button, or set the battery.

| MCP tool | Scenario step | macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `passport_power` | none | yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim power [op] [--duration <DURATION>] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--mv <MV>] [--present] [--soc <SOC>] [--temp-c <TEMP_C>] [--then-run <THEN_RUN>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `duration` | `--duration <DURATION>` | `union` | no | Press length; 600 ms when off, 2200 ms when on. |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `mv` | `--mv <MV>` | `integer` | no | Cell voltage. |
| `op` | `<op>` | `"press"` \| `"hold"` \| `"release"` \| `"battery"` | no | What to do (press). |
| `present` | `--present` | `boolean` | no | Battery connected; omitted leaves it alone, `--no-present` disconnects it. |
| `soc` | `--soc <SOC>` | `integer` | no | Charge percent. |
| `temp_c` | `--temp-c <TEMP_C>` | `integer` | no | Cell temperature. |
| `then_run` | `--then-run <THEN_RUN>` | `union` | no | Run after the edge. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

## Errors

`E_USAGE` (1), `E_STATE` (2), `E_LEASE` (6), `E_GUEST_PANIC` (7), `E_DEADLOCK` (8), `E_STUCK` (9), `E_TRIPWIRE` (10), `E_INTERNAL` (17), `E_HLE` (18). What each means: [errors.md](../errors.md).

## Examples

### Press the power button for the length the rail needs

```sh
passportsim power --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "op": "press"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "op": "press"
}
'@ | passportsim power --json -
```

### Hold the power button down

```sh
passportsim power --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "op": "hold"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "op": "hold"
}
'@ | passportsim power --json -
```

### Run the cell down to 3500 mV at 15 percent

```sh
passportsim power --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "mv": 3500,
  "op": "battery",
  "soc": 15
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "mv": 3500,
  "op": "battery",
  "soc": 15
}
'@ | passportsim power --json -
```
